full_page.content:
1928, February
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 4.
Page 13 Cont.
Dr. Turrell - wife
Edna Souulier - Goiter Cured - promised weekly Com. 6 mo. if it -- She was here only last Wed. - improved
Deaf & Dumb .. . Bright .. Cath Webb - n. cath.
Mrs. Minnie Thomas - Wyandotte in dying condition 7 weeks. To-day - The Dr. her own Brother-in-law .. Doubting T. - Miracle only.
$3000.00 spent in 2 yrs- Agnes Mays - sick two years - in bed since Friday - 3 operations can not find real cause. has appetite but can- not retain
Fr. Zylla's .. Student - Hopeless - Cured.
Vivian Hurlbut 30 not walking since 13th - spinalway.
Page 14
Mrs. Rose Nicol - softening of brain - St. Joseph Retreat
Mrs. --- Operated on for blood-poison 10 times last year, not yet well - asks for prayers.
John Gilbert 5 of 3606 E. Warren - Epiletic fits - 15 - 20 a week - as many as 7 in one day (Natchke)
Mr. Paul Rohrnet - 43 - wife & 5 children 7 yrs. Fits.
Mrs. Catherine Schulte - 4 years penticitis - promises perpetual Enrollment if pains stop for one full month - pains had started just as bad as before operation - about Xmas .. Now perfectly well over a month.
Eloy Chateau 24 of 3463 Montclair operated - a rupture - ether or something got into his eyes and he was hoplessly blind .-- His eyes are restored !! D.G.
Husband away from Sacrament 12 yrs - V. I.P. - stoped in October from drinking - now - comunion.
Page 15
Poor laborer lost his auto - stolen Wm. Bucher
